title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-30
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 39 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 16 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Josh Woodward · Google VP（Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio）
featured.summaryEn: Josh Woodward, VP leading Google Labs and the Gemini App, announced Gemini 4 Carbon, arriving just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon. He says internal sentiment on the model is strong, and it is rolling out to cyber defenders first before wider availability. Gemini also now connects to Strava, turning years of raw workout logs into a personalized coaching plan.
featured.insightZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini App 负责人 Josh Woodward 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 上线——距离 Gemini 4 Argon 发布仅两周，他说内部对这个模型的反馈很好，会先开放给网络安全防御方，再逐步扩大可用范围。同时 Gemini 新增 Strava 连接：可以把多年积累的运动日志变成个性化训练计划。

featured.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创办人
featured.summaryEn: Swyx noted Gemini taking #1 on AAv5, which got him to open up Google's antigravity for the first time in a while for an early review. If Google pulls it off, he says it's officially comeback season, with Meta, Grok and now GDM being cool again. He also observed there are roughly 2x more frontier labs than a year ago — a bizarre counterexample to the bitter lesson.
featured.insightZh: Swyx 注意到 Gemini 在 AAv5 榜单上排到第一，这让他久违地重新打开了 Google 的 antigravity，正在做早期评测。他的判断是：如果 Google 真做成了，那就是正式的"回归季"——Meta、Grok 和 Google DeepMind 都重新变得有意思。他还指出，前沿实验室数量比一年前多了约一倍，这是对"苦涩的教训"（bitter lesson）一个很怪的反例。

featured.title: Can You Use AI To Make Good Art? — With Fred Graver
featured.summaryEn: AI can't tell you what you have to say — empty yourself out first and build your own compass, then use AI as a virtual writers' room; that's how you make good art instead of slop. Fred Graver, a four-time Emmy winner whose career spans National Lampoon, Letterman, Norman Lear and Cheers, then Disney Imagineering, MTV/VH1, early Twitter's TV lead and conversation design at Microsoft, describes every pivot as a step closer to the audience. His method: write a "who I am as a writer" document and a "what I'm working on" document, then ask AI whether the idea fits the person, who the audience is and where they live — even simulating an eight-person focus group with a deliberately negative member. AI isn't writing for you; it's a group of intelligences helping you think. He frames production as a three-step loop — ideation/architecture, production, and reaching the audience — and argues the a…
featured.insightZh: AI 写不出你要说的东西——先把自己"倒空"、建立自己的罗盘，再把 AI 当成虚拟编剧室，它才能帮你做出好作品而不是 slop。 Fred Graver 是四届艾美奖得主，履历横跨 National Lampoon、Letterman 深夜秀、Norman Lear、Cheers，后做过迪士尼 Imagineer、MTV/VH1、早期 Twitter 的电视业务负责人，还在微软做过对话设计师。他职业生涯每一次转向的共同主线是"离观众更近一步"。他的方法论：先写一份"我是谁"文档（灵感、偏好、志向），再写一份"我在做什么"文档，然后让 AI 判断这个想法和这个人是否匹配、谁是受众、他们在哪些平台。他强调这不是让 AI 替你写，而是把 AI 当作虚拟编剧室，甚至可以模拟一个包含"刺头"的八人焦点小组。 他把影视创作拆成三步闭环：构思/架构（产出剧本）、制作（含筹备、分镜、剪辑）、触达观众（营销发行），并主张把装配线变成圆环——构思阶段就让营销做"代理预告片"测试售票意愿。关于 AI slop，他的核心观点是：每一步都要先深度思考，花一两天手写或语音把自己知道的全部倒出来，"打开 AI 之后你就再没有这个机会了"。AI 会回归均值，不能告诉你该说什么；有罗盘的人能让 AI 为己所用，没有罗盘的人只会跟着 Claude 走。 实操上，他长期"住在 Claude 里"：建了若干"读者"skill，还有一个被刻意设定为"很难相处"的晨间督促 agent，会质问他为什么半夜又冒出新点子、偏离了既定计划；Claude 记得他做过的决策，ChatGPT 像"读遍所有教材却不懂其意"的电影学院学生，擅长检查规定动作，再用 NotebookLM 的播客功能听反馈。他认为前两步已基本就绪，真正的难题是第三步——黄金时代的电视工作"回不来了"，创作者需要类似 Kevin Kelly"一千个铁杆粉丝"的新商业模式。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad shared that ViBench 2.0, a prompt-to-app benchmark, just dropped, with GPT 6.1 Sol taking the lead — a new reference point for comparing end-to-end app-generation capability across models.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 发布了 ViBench 2.0——一个"从 prompt 到 app"的基准测试，本轮 GPT 6.1 Sol 拿下第一。对关心"vibe coding 端到端生成可用应用"能力的团队来说，这是一个新的横向比较参照。

items.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
items.summaryEn: Boris Cherny, who leads Claude Code at Anthropic, shared results from Utah: the state gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 agencies; 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, and 71% reported saving 20+ hours by the end of the four-week pilot — a concrete public-sector adoption data point.
items.insightZh: Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 分享了美国犹他州的政府试点数据：州政府向 10 个机构的 34 名开发者提供 Claude Code，80% 在 30 分钟内跑通了工作环境，四周试点结束时 71% 报告节省了 20 小时以上。这是公共部门落地 AI 编程工具的一个具体样本。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Claude for Legal added a gallery of ready-made artifacts for contract review, regulatory horizon scans, cite checks and more. Users can start from a built-in example, add their own documents and connectors, and share it across the business.
items.insightZh: Claude for Legal 新增"现成 artifact 库"：覆盖合同审查、监管动态扫描、引注核查等场景。用户可以从内置示例出发，接入自己的文档和连接器，再分享给整个业务团队使用。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared three things. First, model aliases — "DNS for models" — that resolve to a specific model and enable traffic steering, keeping teams off stale versions, cutting cost and removing decision paralysis. Second, Vercel AI Gateway will serve Particle's models and inference in partnership with Suhail. Third, he pitched Vercel CI as the answer to the AI coding bottleneck: fast, stable infrastructure (20 global clusters, millions of microVMs per day), Turborepo integration that computes the…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 今天发了三件事。第一，Vercel 推出一种"模型别名"能力，他称之为"模型的 DNS"：别名解析到具体模型，从而可以做流量调度，解决团队卡在旧模型版本、成本优化和选型纠结等问题。第二，Vercel AI Gateway 将与 Suhail 的 Particle 合作，提供 Particle 的模型和推理服务。第三，他把 Vercel CI 定位为"AI 编程瓶颈"的解法：快速稳定的基础设施（20 个全球集群、每天数百万 microVM）、Turborepo 集成（依赖图自动计算、跳过和缓存已完成工作），以及 Agentic CI——CLI 里的 `vercel ci` 让 agent 能检查、中止、触发、重放 CI，未来甚至能判断"这些测试值不值得跑"。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues agents will consume 1,000x more tokens than we do today as they run in workflows, process our data, build nearly all software and secure enterprises. Scaling that requires multiple frontier approaches: pushing closed models further while making open-weights models more capable, more secure and more efficient for large workloads. He called out Suhail's Particle as exciting on this front.
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为 agent 消耗的 token 将是今天的 1000 倍——它们会跑在工作流里、处理所有数据、构建几乎所有软件、保障企业安全。要支撑这种规模，需要多条前沿路线并行：继续推进闭源模型边界，同时提升开源权重模型的能力、安全性和大负载下的效率。他点名看好 Suhail 的 Particle 在这方面的工作。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President Garry Tan also backed Particle, saying it will be at the frontier for the smartest model at the lowest dollar per unit of intelligence. Separately, he flagged a school budget crunch where honors classes are being phased out while other new classes are being added.
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 同样为 Particle 站台，称其将站在"最聪明模型 + 最低单位智能成本"的前沿。另外他吐槽了学校的预算紧缩：高中生的荣誉课程正在被砍，同时却在加别的新课。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux continued his series (Day 24): you can text your dot like any other contact, making it easy to forward things, leave voice notes, or even say "Hey Siri, text Iggy to…". He also clarified that bringing Chat and Work capabilities together is in progress but not rolling out yet; the plan is to do it carefully at some point this year, with more to share soon.
items.insightZh: OpenAI 的 Thibault Sottiaux 继续他的系列分享（第 24 天）：可以像给普通联系人发短信一样给"dot"发消息，方便转发内容、留语音备忘，甚至用"Hey Siri, text Iggy to…"下达请求。他还澄清了一个误会：把 Chat 和 Work 能力整合的工作正在进行但尚未推出，计划今年内谨慎推进，后续会有更多信息。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang thinks world models are still in the GPT-3.5 era — like the old Will Smith eating spaghetti videos, impressive but not quite there — though not for long. At the GPT-5/6 stage, the implications are big: a dragon-battle VFX shot that takes months could be generated from a single director's frame; in games, graphics and sound are already good but core loops and progression aren't, yet world models plus coding models could make building your own game as fun as playing a mass-market one. He also called ChatG…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 认为世界模型目前还处在"GPT-3.5 时代"，就像当年的"威尔·史密斯吃意面"视频——惊艳但还不够好，不过不会太久。一旦到了 GPT-5/6 阶段，影响会很大：电影里一个龙战特效镜头要 VFX 工作室做几个月，未来导演给一帧就能让 AI 生成整场戏；游戏方面，世界模型的画面和音效已经不错，但核心循环、成长系统等玩法还不行，不过它会让任何人都能做出好看好听的游戏，"做自己的游戏"可能像玩大众游戏一样有趣。他还提到 ChatGPT 加浏览器操作帮他处理医疗文书非常好用。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Former Claude Code team member Thariq noted something odd: technical people are sad, thinking their skills are now useless, while non-technical people desperately wish they were more technical to use agents better. He sees the same in creative fields — artists worry about AI, yet he wishes he could sketch animation and character concepts for an agent to flesh out, because he lacks the language.
items.insightZh: 前 Claude Code 成员 Thariq 观察到一个奇怪的现象：技术人员很沮丧，觉得自己的技能没用了；非技术人员却拼命希望自己更懂技术，好用好 agent。他认为创意领域也一样——艺术家担心 AI，但他自己恨不得能画草图表达动画和角色构想让 agent 去完善，因为他"没有那套语言"。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu wrote an essay, "augmenting human intellect": he didn't start making software dreaming of a factory but of computers as extensions of the mind. Drawing on Engelbart (1962), Licklider (1960) and Ingalls' Smalltalk (1981), he argues computing began with the human, not the autonomous machine, and that today's story of "more agents, more output from fewer people" is too small. Not everything difficult is overhead; sometimes moving the pieces is how you understand them. He wants AI that lets people have a living…
items.insightZh: Ryo Lu 写了一篇长文《增强人类智能》：他做软件的初衷不是"工厂"，而是让电脑成为思维的延伸。他回溯 Engelbart（1962）、Licklider（1960）、Ingalls（1981 Smalltalk）的传统——计算的起点是人，而不是自主机器。他批评当下"更多自动化、更多 agent、更少的人产出更多"的叙事太窄：不是所有困难都是开销，有时亲手摆弄才能理解问题。他希望 AI 让人能与软件建立活的关系——问为什么、改一部分、撤销、学会下一次自己改；"机器可以变得更强，而不让人变得更小"，而这需要刻意设计。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人（现 OpenAI）
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger said OpenClaw's web UI now works offline with smarter websocket compression and reconnect logic — he got plenty done on a flight to Vienna despite spotty wifi. He also joked about how easy it is to tell agent-written bugs from human ones.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 表示，OpenClaw 的 Web UI 现已支持离线使用，并采用了更智能的 websocket 压缩/重连逻辑——他在飞往维也纳的航班上，网络时断时续，依然完成了大量工作。他还调侃：agent 写的 bug 和人写的 bug 一眼就能分清。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal, SPC General Partner and former Dropbox CTO, shared an LP letter on lessons from a decade of spotting talent at the frontier. He agrees early-stage investing is "90% about the founder" but finds that claim lacking in falsifiability, specificity and repeatability, so the letter tries to define the dimensions of excellence and how they translate into companies.
items.insightZh: 前 Dropbox CTO、SPC 合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 公开了一封 LP 信，总结十年前沿投资中识别人才的经验。他认同"早期投资 90% 看创始人"，但不满意这句话缺乏可证伪性、具体性和可复制性——信中试图回答：卓越的维度有哪些？它们如何转化为公司表现？

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari published a piece for seed founders on bridging the gap between their dream and what's typically required at Series A, from the perspective of someone on the other side of the table, reviewed by several investors and founders.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 发布了一篇写给种子轮创始人的文章，从 A 轮投资人视角讲如何弥合"种子轮愿景"与"A 轮实际要求"之间的差距，草稿经过多位投资人和创始人审阅。
